2608.06110.title: ECHO: A Locally-Deployable Agentic Health Assistant with Temporal Memory, Safety Guardrails, and Speech Assessment
2608.06110.paper_summary: This paper presents ECHO (Enhanced Care & Health Observer), a locally-deployable conversational health assistant for long-term chronic care management. ECHO integrates three complementary software modules developed under shared supervision as a unified system. The core module is an agentic chatbot built on a ReAct loop orchestrated via LangGraph, equipped with 17 clinical tools and a temporal knowledge graph for persistent cross-session memory; it achieves a 94.9% tool-execution pass rate across a 59-scenario benchmark with GPT-5 Mini. A two-stage hybrid safety layer intercepts all incoming queries: a rule-based layer handles explicit crisis signals and jailbreak attempts in under 1ms, while a signed graph neural network (GNN) with APPNP-style propagation classifies boundary cases by clinical intent, achieving 88.8% accuracy and 90.6% unsafe recall on a 2,537-query annotated Turkish health dataset while outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines including Llama 3.3 70B. A multimodal speech assessment module combining Whisper acoustic encoding and BERT text encoding with cross-attention fusion estimates emotion, depression, and pain, reaching a mean macro F1 of 0.652. The full system is implemented as a web application that can run entirely on consumer hardware, with no patient data transmitted to external services, supporting compliance with GDPR and KVKK.
2608.06110.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了ECHO（增強護理與健康觀察者），這是一個可在本地部署的對話式健康助手，用於長期慢性病管理。ECHO整合了三個在共享監督下開發的互補軟體模組，作為一個統一系統。核心模組是一個基於ReAct循環的代理聊天機器人，通過LangGraph協調，配備了17個臨床工具和一個持久的跨會話記憶的時間知識圖；它在使用GPT-5 Mini的59個場景基準測試中實現了94.9%的工具執行通過率。二階段混合安全層攔截所有進入的查詢：一個基於規則的層在1毫秒內處理明確的危機信號和越獄嘗試，而一個帶有APPNP風格傳播的簽名圖神經網絡（GNN）根據臨床意圖對邊界案例進行分類，實現了88.8%的準確率和90.6%的不安全召回率，在一個2,537條註釋的土耳其健康數據集上表現超過包括Llama 3.3 70B在內的零樣本LLM基準。結合Whisper聲學編碼和BERT文本編碼的多模態語音評估模組，通過交叉注意力融合估計情感、抑鬱和疼痛，達到平均宏F1值0.652。整個系統實現為一個網頁應用程序，可以完全在消費者硬體上運行，並且不會將患者數據傳輸到外部服務，支持遵守GDPR和KVKK。
